falt.contentDescription: This advertisement, run by the Facebook page "ORVO" (page ID 1299101096626433), reproduces our copyrighted advertising material without authorisation. The ad's video is cut from our own ad films "CaraShellRoof_CO_101_H1", "CaraShellRoof_NO_SP_104_H1", "CaraShellRoof_US_CO_101_H1" (published by us on 18 September 2026, before this ad started running on 24 September 2026): 3 still frames from different scenes of the reported video (at 0:16, 0:19, 0:20) are identical to frames of our films (perceptual-hash distance 0, 5, 1/64), and 34% of the reported video's sampled frames match our films frame for frame (compared against 174 of our films). Our original ads are public in Meta's Ad Library: "CaraShellRoof_CO_101_H1" https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=1090434320417515, "CaraShellRoof_NO_SP_104_H1" https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=1039301885772918. It copies our ads "CaraShellRoof_CO_101_H1", "CaraShellRoof_NO_SP_104_H1", "CaraShellRoof_US_CO_101_H1" for the product "Taköverdrag Husvagn & Husbil 5,5–13,5 m", which our page ran before this ad appeared. This is report 1 of 8 concerning ads from the same advertiser; each ad is reported separately.
